name: rosetta-kirkpatrick-seidel-algorithm

use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

struct P(x: double, y: double) is
    -(o: P) -> P => P(x - o.x, y - o.y)
    ×(o: P) -> double => x * o.y - y * o.x
    show: string => "({x:F3}, {y:F3})"
si

slope(p: P, q: P) -> double => (q.y - p.y) / (q.x - p.x)

median(values: Iterable[double]) -> double =>
    let sorted = values |> sort((a, b) => a <> b) |> collect_list() in
    sorted[(sorted.count - 1) / 2]

leftmost(points: List[P]) -> P =>
    points |> reduce(points[0], (b, p) =>
        if p.x < b.x \/ (p.x == b.x /\ p.y > b.y) then p else b fi)

rightmost(points: List[P]) -> P =>
    points |> reduce(points[0], (b, p) =>
        if p.x > b.x \/ (p.x == b.x /\ p.y > b.y) then p else b fi)

bridge(points: List[P], a: double) -> (P, P) is
    if points.count == 2 then
        let p = points[0], q = points[1]

        return if p.x < q.x then (p, q) else (q, p) fi
    fi

    let kept = LIST[P]()
    let pairs = LIST[(P, P)]()

    for i in 0..points.count / 2 do
        let p = points[2 * i], q = points[2 * i + 1]
        let (left, right) = if p.x < q.x then (p, q) else (q, p) fi

        if left.x == right.x then
            kept.add(if left.y > right.y then left else right fi)
        else
            pairs.add((left, right))
        fi
    od

    if points.count % 2 == 1 then
        kept.add(points[points.count - 1])
    fi

    if pairs.count == 0 then
        return bridge(kept, a)
    fi

    let k = median(pairs |> map(((p, q)) => slope(p, q)))
    let height = (p: P) => p.y - k * p.x
    let top = points |> map(height) |> reduce(height(points[0]), Math.max)
    let touching =
        points |> filter(p => height(p) >= top - 1.0e-12) |> collect_list()

    let low = leftmost(touching)
    let high = rightmost(touching)

    if low.x <= a /\ a < high.x then
        return (low, high)
    fi

    for (p, q) in pairs do
        let s = slope(p, q)

        if high.x <= a then
            if s < k then kept.add(p) fi
            kept.add(q)
        else
            kept.add(p)
            if s > k then kept.add(q) fi
        fi
    od

    bridge(kept, a)
si

upper(points: List[P], first: P, last: P) -> List[P] is
    if points.count <= 1 /\ first =~ last then
        return LIST([first])
    fi

    let (left, right) = bridge(points, median(points |> map(p => p.x)))

    let before =
        if left =~ first then LIST([first])
        else
            let part = points |> filter(p => p.x <= left.x) in
            upper(part |> collect_list(), first, left)
        fi

    let after =
        if right =~ last then LIST([last])
        else
            let part = points |> filter(p => p.x >= right.x) in
            upper(part |> collect_list(), right, last)
        fi

    before |> cat(after) |> collect_list()
si

upper_hull(points: List[P]) -> List[P] is
    let first = leftmost(points), last = rightmost(points)
    let between = points |> filter(p => p.x > first.x /\ p.x < last.x)

    upper(between |> cat([first, last]) |> collect_list(), first, last)
si

flipped(points: Iterable[P]) -> List[P] =>
    points |> map(p => P(p.x, -p.y)) |> collect_list()

backwards(items: List[P]) -> List[P] =>
    (0..items.count)
        |> map(i => items[items.count - 1 - i])
        |> collect_list()

hull(points: List[P]) -> List[P] =>
    let top = upper_hull(points) in
    let bottom = flipped(upper_hull(flipped(points))) in
    let inner = backwards(bottom) |> skip(1) |> take(bottom.count - 2) in
    top |> cat(inner) |> collect_list()

turns_left(o: P, a: P, b: P) -> bool => (a - o) × (b - o) >= 0.0D

monotone_chain(points: List[P]) -> List[P] is
    let sorted = points |> sort((a, b) => a.x <> b.x) |> collect_list()
    let chain = LIST[P]()

    for pass in [sorted, backwards(sorted)] do
        let start = chain.count

        for p in pass do
            while chain.count >= start + 2 /\
                turns_left(
                    chain[chain.count - 2], chain[chain.count - 1], p)
            do
                chain.remove_at(chain.count - 1)
            od

            chain.add(p)
        od

        chain.remove_at(chain.count - 1)
    od

    chain
si

let random = System.Random(11)
let points =
    (0..300)
        |> map(_ =>
            let angle = 2.0D * Math.pi * random.next_double() in
            let r = Math.sqrt(random.next_double()) in
            P(r * Math.cos(angle), r * Math.sin(angle)))
        |> collect_list()

let result = hull(points)
let agrees = SET(result).set_equals(monotone_chain(points))

write_line("{points.count} points, {result.count} on the hull:")
result |> each(p => write_line("  {p.show}"))
write_line("")
write_line("the same set as the monotone chain finds: {agrees}")

let image = IMAGE(360, 360)

image.view(-1.1D, -1.1D, 1.1D, 1.1D)
image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)
image.colour(120ub, 130ub, 150ub)

for p in points do
    image.dot(p.x, p.y, 2.0D)
od

image.colour(200ub, 50ub, 40ub)
image.stroke(2.0D)
image.line(
    result
        |> cat([result[0]])
        |> map(p => (x = p.x, y = p.y))
        |> collect_list())

image.write("hull.png")

image.show("hull.png")
